description: Header file defining the DhcpPacFileAdapterFetcher class responsible for DHCP lookup and PAC file fetching on Windows, including class declarations, methods, and internal state management.

classes.name: DhcpPacFileAdapterFetcher
classes.description: Manages DHCP lookup and PAC file fetching for a network adapter on Windows, including state management, callbacks, and internal fetcher classes.

classes.name: DhcpQuery
classes.description: Encapsulates DHCP query work on a worker thread, retrieving the PAC URL from DHCP.

methods.name: DhcpPacFileAdapterFetcher
methods.description: Constructor initializing the fetcher with URL request context and task runner.

methods.name: Fetch
methods.description: Starts DHCP lookup and PAC file fetch process for a specified network adapter.

methods.name: DidFinish
methods.description: Checks if the fetch process has completed successfully.

methods.name: GetResult
methods.description: Returns the network error code resulting from the fetch operation.

methods.name: GetPacScript
methods.description: Returns the fetched PAC script content if available.

methods.name: GetPacURL
methods.description: Returns the PAC URL retrieved from DHCP.

methods.name: GetPacURLFromDhcp
methods.description: Static method to synchronously get PAC URL from DHCP for a given adapter.

methods.name: state
methods.description: Returns current state of the fetcher state machine.

methods.name: ImplCreateScriptFetcher
methods.description: Virtual method to create a PacFileFetcher instance.

methods.name: ImplCreateDhcpQuery
methods.description: Virtual method to create a DhcpQuery instance.

methods.name: ImplGetTimeout
methods.description: Virtual method to get timeout duration.

methods.name: OnFetcherDone
methods.description: Handles completion of PAC file fetch.
